messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Wanted: proof-readers !
parts:
Dear all,

right now, Andy Royle and I are finishing the writing of the 2nd volume of the Applied Hierarchical Modeling for Ecologists book project (i.e., AHM2). Academic Press tell us that they will send us the proofs startin in the last week of August.

Now, we are looking for 1-3 additional proof-readers for each of the 12 chapters which are listed here:

12. Relative-abundance models for population dynamics
13. Modeling population dynamics while accounting for imperfect detection
14. Hierarchical models of survival
15. Modeling species distribution and range dynamics using dynamic occupancy models
16. Modeling metacommunity dynamics using dynamic community models
17. Multi-state occupancy models
18. Modeling false-positives
19. Models for species interactions
20. Spatial modeling for abundance and occupancy
21. Integrated models
22. Spatial distance sampling and spatial capture-recapture (SCR)
23. Conclusions

If you're interested in helping us and and could do the proofs for one or more chapters, please let us know. We would expect you to give a chapter one thorough read and return to us within 1 week from receipt any detected errors or serious awkwardnesses in the text.

The audience of this mail is not limited to the two Google groups to which it is sent, so if you like you can also forward to colleagues who you think might be interested.

Thank you very much.

Best regards  --- Marc & Andy

______________________________________________________________
 
Marc Kéry
Tel. ++41 41 462 97 93
marc...@vogelwarte.ch
www.vogelwarte.ch
Swiss Ornithological Institute | Seerose 1 | CH-6204 Sempach | Switzerland

(3) Kéry & Royle (2016): Applied hierarchical modeling in ecology, Academic Press, Volume 1, Prelude and Static Models, see www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/keryroylebook/
(2) Kéry & Schaub (2012): Bayesian Population Analysis using WinBUGS, Academic Press; see www.vogelwarte.ch/bpa
(1) Kéry (2010): Introduction to WinBUGS for Ecologists, Academic Press; see www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/kerybook

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: AW: Wanted: proof-readers !
parts:
Dear all,

 

Just a brief update on the AHM2 project: many of you have replied and offered help. Thank you very much indeed !

 

Now, not quite surprisingly perhaps, we are a little bit behind with the project: we submitted everything by the end of the summer vacations, but then the submitted material proved to be too much, so now we are going over everything and try to shorten by about 20%.

 

Once we have this and get a new ETA for the proofs, we will notify on these lists and when we have the proofs try to distribute among the people who have responded. Due to the number of people who have offered help, we may not approach every one of you and this will not mean anything negative, just that we can’t handle too many proof readers.

 

Thanks for your help and patience,
Best regards --- Marc & Andy
